legend: A permutation of size N%%ZSMJ0%% is an array containing distinct values between [1,N]%%ZSMJ1%%.
Define the score of a permutation P%%ZSMJ2%% of size n%%ZSMJ3%% as the sum of the number of divisors for every P[i]%%ZSMJ4%% that appear strictly before it in the permutation, more formally:
For example, the score of permutation {2,1,3,4}%%ZSMJ6%% is 3%%ZSMJ7%%.
Your task is to find the sum of scores for all permutations of size n.
Since the answer might be very large, output it modulo 109+7%%ZSMJ8%%.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases T%%ZSMJ9%% (1≤T≤105%%ZSMJ10%%). Description of the test cases follows.
Each of the following T%%ZSMJ11%% lines contains a single integer N%%ZSMJ12%% (1≤N≤105%%ZSMJ13%%), the size of the permutations.
output: For each test case, print in one line the total sum of scores of all permutations in this test case module 1000000007%%ZSMJ14%%.
